```{mermaid}
%%{init: {'themeVariables': {'edgeLabelBackground':'#00000000'}}}%%
%%| fig-width: 10
flowchart TD
    %% -- DATA & STATIONARITY STAGE --
    Start([Raw Time Series Data]) --> CheckStat{Is Data Stationary?}
    
    CheckStat -->|No| N01[Non-Stationary Data & Transformations]
    N01 -->|Differencing / Logs| CheckStat
    
    %% -- MEAN MODELING STAGE --
    CheckStat -->|Yes| MeanModel{Choose Mean Model}
    MeanModel -->|Seasonality| N03[Seasonal ARIMA]
    MeanModel -->|No Seasonality| N02[ARMA Models]
    MeanModel -->|Exogenous Vars| N08[TS Regression]

    N02 --> N04[Estimation, Validation & Selection]
    N03 --> N04
    N08 --> N04

    %% -- VARIANCE / VOLATILITY STAGE --
    N04 --> VolCheck{Check Residuals: Is Volatility Constant?}
    
    VolCheck -->|No ARCH Effects| N05[Forecasting]
    
    VolCheck -->|ARCH Effects Present| N06[GARCH Models]
    N06 --> AsymCheck{Asymmetric Shocks?}
    AsymCheck -->|Yes| N07[Asymmetric Volatility]
    AsymCheck -->|No| VolDone((Volatility Modeled))
    N07 --> VolDone
    
    %% -- APPLICATION STAGE --
    VolDone --> N09[Market Risk]
    VolDone --> N05

    %% -- PROBLEM SETS (Mapped via dotted lines) --
    N01 -.-> PS01([Problem Set 01])
    N05 -.-> PS02([Problem Set 02])
    N06 -.-> PS03([Problem Set 03])

    %% -- CLASSES / STYLING --
    class N01,N02,N03,N04,N05,N06,N07,N08,N09 nav-node
    class PS01,PS02,PS03 project-node

    %% -- CLICKABLE LINKS --
    click N01 "notes/01/intro.html" "Go to Non-Stationary Data Transformation Notes"
    click N02 "notes/02/models.html" "Go to ARMA(p,q) Notes"
    click N03 "notes/03/arima.html" "Go to Seasonal ARIMA Model Notes"
    click N04 "notes/04/estimation.html" "Go to Model Estimation, Selection, and Validation Notes"
    click N05 "notes/05/forecasting.html" "Go to Forecasting Notes"
    click N06 "notes/06/garch.html" "Go to GARCH(p,q) Notes"
    click N07 "notes/07/asymmetric_vol.html" "Go to Asymmetric Volatility Notes"
    click N08 "notes/08/ts_regression.html" "Go to Time Series Regression Notes"
    click N09 "notes/09/market_risk.html" "Go to Market Risk Notes"
    click PS01 "problem_sets/HW_1_Transformations/01ps_final.html" "Go to Problem Set 01"
    click PS02 "problem_sets/HW_2_Forecasting/hw02.html" "Go to Problem Set 02"
    click PS03 "problem_sets/HW_3_ARCH_GARCH/ARCH_GARCH.html" "Go to Problem Set 03"

    %% STYLE THE LINES

    %% 1. Neutral / Main Pathway Lines
    linkStyle 0,1,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,13,14,15,16,17,18 stroke:#8b949e,stroke-width:2px;

    %% 2. "Yes" / Success / Forward Logic
    linkStyle 3,11 stroke:#05b682,stroke-width:2px;

    %% 3. "No" / Loopback / Warning Logic
    linkStyle 2,12 stroke:#e06c75,stroke-width:2px;

    %% 4. Problem Set Dotted Links
    linkStyle 19,20,21 stroke:#8b949e,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray:5;
```
